title: Structured Repository
changes: Reorganized the repository into css, js, data, and structured asset folders while keeping only core PWA entry files at the root.
Moved profile imagery, PWA icons, app logos, and the Hub QR code into dedicated asset subfolders.
Updated every runtime, manifest, cache, and data reference to the new paths without changing the approved visual design.
Renamed internal v13-prefixed UI classes to stable app-prefixed names for cleaner long-term maintenance.
Updated Service Worker data caching so nested data files retain their correct canonical cache paths.
Expanded CI validation to enforce the v1.4.0 repository structure and prevent loose legacy files from returning.

title: Audit Hardening
changes: Improved text and control contrast while preserving the approved compact visual design.
Added keyboard focus containment, Escape handling, background inert state, and focus restoration for dialogs.
Registered the Service Worker earlier and bypassed the HTTP cache when checking for worker updates.
Changed local images and the manifest to stale-while-revalidate so updated assets refresh automatically.
Consolidated active CSS and JavaScript into style.css and app.js and removed the legacy v13 split files.
Hardened the Content Security Policy and synchronized the browser and manifest theme colors.
Expanded GitHub Actions checks for synchronized versions, security directives, assets, URLs, and the data model.

title: Identity & Smart Launching
changes: Added real app logos for GLP-1 Companion and AI Council.
Added compact LIVE/BETA/COMING SOON/MAINTENANCE status support.
Added app version and last-updated metadata.
Added QR sharing, app details, enhanced sharing, and copy actions.
Added configurable accent colors through config.json.
Added order and featured-app support in links.json.
Added a private on-device visit counter with no external tracking by default.
Improved offline behavior and cached data/assets.
Expanded GitHub Actions validation for the new v1.3.0 data model.

title: Compact Mobile Launcher
changes: Rebuilt the Hub around a centered phone-first launcher layout.
Added compact Install, Share and Copy actions.
Enabled silent PWA updates.
